title: Phase Optimizer
summary: Throw to grant Steel Watchers an additional Action.

fields.Throw: Action, single use. Burst radius 13 ft. Applies Phase Optimizer Active for 2 turns to Steel Watchers hit, granting an additional Action. The item does not list direct damage or a saving throw.
fields.Acquisition: Loot from Gortash. Pickpocketing can yield four.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
